Properties

CanBeRendered

True when the texture can be bound into a shader, for use in rendering. If this is false, please refrain from binding it, you can copy from it or resolve into/from it but not bind it directly.

public bool CanBeRendered { get; }

Property Value

bool

CanBeUnorderedAccess

True when the texture can be bound into a shader as an unordered access view. This is usually for compute shaders, but you could do it in a regular shader too if you wanted.

public bool CanBeUnorderedAccess { get; }

Property Value

bool

ReadbackRegionAsImage(uint, uint, uint, uint, uint, uint)

Reads back a region of the texture as a RawImageData. Only supported for RGBA8 and BGRA8 formats; BGRA8 channels are swapped to RGBA8 automatically.

public RawImageData? ReadbackRegionAsImage(uint x, uint y, uint width, uint height, uint arrayIndex = 0, uint mipLevel = 0)

Upload(byte[], AuraColorFormat, uint, uint)

Uploads data to the texture. The data must be the entire texture x and y dimensions multiplied by the size of the format in bytes. For example, for a 256x256 RGBA8 texture, the data should be 256 * 256 * 4 = 262144 bytes.

public bool Upload(byte[] data, AuraColorFormat format, uint arrayIndex = 0, uint mipLevel = 0)
